verdict_reason: The renamed read-preference test is a clearer assertion than the tautology it replaced, but it only exercises the integration-test profile's own duplicate of the property so it does not guard the production default its comment describes.

todos.issue: The new primaryPreferred assertion is satisfied by the test profile's own copy of the property (src/test/resources/application-integration-test.yml:13 sets read-preference: primaryPreferred), so it does not lock the production default the comment claims to protect — reverting src/main/resources/application.yml:13 to 'secondary' leaves this test green.
todos.fix: Delete the read-preference key from application-integration-test.yml so the integration-test profile inherits the main application.yml value, making this assertion a real regression guard on the production default.
